title: Passive start survives 2 minutes
steps: Empty storage, 390x844 touch, DB blocked, Home > PLAY, tap Thicket Ranger
actual: Alive at T118 s with HP 50/100 (dropped 100 to 50 in the first 25 s, then stable). Coach stays on step 1/6 'Drag the left stick to walk around' and never blocks. One run only.

title: Reward event about every 20-30 s when playing with both sticks; coach reaches 5/6 within 75 s
steps: Fresh profile, Thicket Ranger, drag left stick, drag right stick to fire, tap the ability button each loop (CDP touch events)
expected: Level up and drops early, survivable
actual: Run A (sticks only, never tapped the ability): 110 s, HP 27/100, 17/30 xp, 4 shards, coach stuck at 4/6 'Tap an ability button'. Run B (ability tapped): Lv 2 at 40 s, 20 shards at 140 s, HP 100-108 until 130 s, coach 5/6 at 73 s. No death in 150 s in either run.

title: Coach card with Skip shows 'Drag the left stick to walk around 1/6' as soon as the hero is picked
actual: Card top-left under the HUD with Skip, danger chip 'Shore - Safe-ish / Comfortable' beside it. Isles also opens with an objective line (vine rope NW) and a creature in view.

title: No key names on Town join card, Town HUD, Isles, Pop, Dash or the Realm skip link on a phone
steps: Phone, regex WASD|arrow keys|Enter or Space|Space or click|Esc over body text of each page
actual: No match on any of the 6 pages. Town join footer reads 'Drag the stick to walk, tap A to interact ... tap C to chat'. Realm skip link reads 'Play: focus the game'. Join card shows hint 'Type your name to join.' and a '<- Home' pill.

title: Footer is just 'Daily gift' + 'Map'; no '<- Town' or 'Open'
actual: Two buttons only. Backup is an inline tile next to Collections.

title: Fresh device: sheet says 'Gift claimed. 36 shards were added to your Realm purse.'
actual: Sheet shows Days claimed: 1 and button 'Claimed today'. It was already claimed when the sheet opened; I did not see an unclaimed state, so the Claim tap itself was not observed.

title: Backup tile opens a readable section with 'Back up everything' and 'Restore from a file'
actual: Text 'One file holds the town, the Realm, every game and your settings. Restore accepts old town files and Lantern backups too.' Neither button was pressed.

title: Town HUD improved (no 12 counters, no Hold to talk) but 'Where to?' still top-right, no Menu top-left, A / C still 50x50
actual: 'Where to?' 118x44 at (260,62), A 50x50, C 50x50, Emotes/Tools 64x50. #mm-nav-btn absent in Town. Bag bar is one row. A label 'Skills 55 / 10' by the Shop is clipped at the left screen edge.

title: Realm HUD still has compass + 3 buttons + Leave on top, Daily and gear between thumbs; heavy tint and stripe noise over the ground
actual: Same layout as round 2. In the passive screenshot the screen is tinted red/purple with many small red dots on the ground and a dim hero; ground reads stripy.

title: Floating compass Menu button overlaps the 'Next:' line when Home is scrolled
steps: Phone, Home, open Backup (page scrolls down)
actual: Compass button sits on top of the 'Next: the guided adventure' text (b08-r3-03).
